fine_trace.note: Attacker-controlled NUL-terminated string is passed to the expression parser; the fuzzer input is the raw expression text.
A leading constant (e.g. a decimal integer) is parsed into c1; if the next token is not a relational operator and c1 is a single unmasked decimal 0 or 1, it becomes a boolean literal.
When the constant is followed by a relational operator and a field, make_cmp is called with the reversed operator and the constant set c1.
type_check verifies the constant set type and width against the field; for a string field (width 0) the constant must be EXPR_C_STRING.
make_cmp__ copies the constant value/mask into the new EXPR_T_CMP node; for a string field it duplicates c->string.
For a string field (symbol->width == 0), the constant's string is duplicated into the comparison node.
Annotation resolves the symbol; for a string field the symbol has width 0 and no parent/predicate, so the cmp node is returned unchanged.
For a string-field comparison (width 0), expr_simplify returns the cmp node unchanged; no mask/value processing occurs.
A single EXPR_T_CMP node is returned unchanged by normalization.

fine_trace.code: case EXPR_T_CMP: add_cmp_flow(expr, lookup_port, aux, matches); break;
fine_trace.note: The normalized cmp node is dispatched to add_cmp_flow for conversion to a match.
constrain_match is invoked on the string-field comparison to populate the match.
For a string field, the comparison string is looked up in the port table; if not found, the match is dropped.

fine_trace.code: union mf_subvalue x; memset(&x, 0, sizeof x); x.integer = htonll(port);
fine_trace.note: The port number is written into a zero-initialized mf_subvalue; the value is fully initialized before use.
The port value is written into the match; the string-field path is fully initialized and does not reach the uninitialized-value bug.
